options.name: config_file
options.description: Path to the kopia configuration file describing the connection. Defaults to kopia's own configuration path when unset.

options.name: options
options.description: Storage provider flags passed to C(kopia repository create) and C(kopia repository connect), given as snake_case keys. Each key becomes the matching kebab-case CLI flag, so V(bucket) becomes C(--bucket) and V(storage_account) becomes C(--storage-account). Booleans toggle the flag, V(true) emits C(--flag) and V(false) emits C(--no-flag), and a list repeats the flag once per element. Put credential-carrying flags in O(secrets) instead so they stay out of logs.

options.name: password
options.description: Password securing the kopia repository. Exported to the kopia CLI as E(KOPIA_PASSWORD), never on the command line.

options.name: secrets
options.description: Storage provider flags whose values are secrets, such as V(secret_access_key) or V(key). Converted to CLI flags exactly like O(options), but kept out of logs.

options.name: validate_provider
options.description: Run C(kopia repository validate-provider) after creating a repository. Only runs on creation, never for an existing repository.
